fresnel_reflectance — 3D optics op

• Data kinds: measurement → measurement

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fresnel_reflectance(cos_i, eta1=1.0, eta2=1.5) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.fresnel_reflectance(cos_i, eta1=1.0, eta2=1.5); from the registry, ops3d.get("fresnel_reflectance"))

Usage

Fresnel reflectance (unpolarised = the s/p average). The share that splits into reflection and transmission at a transparent interface.

At normal incidence ((n1−n2)/(n1+n2))² (air→glass=0.04). Beyond the critical angle 1.0 (total internal reflection). For rendering/inspecting transparent bodies.

cos_i is the cosine of the angle of incidence (a real scalar; arrays and None raise ValueError). The sign is discarded (|cos_i|). eta1 is the refractive index of the incident side, eta2 that of the transmitted side. Returns the mean of s-polarisation rs and p-polarisation rp as a float ([0, 1]). At the Brewster angle rp = 0, but the mean does not become 0. cos_i = 0 (grazing incidence) gives 1.0. Transmittance is 1 − reflectance (no absorption).

Uses: weights of rays bent with refract, luminance prediction of transparent bodies.
